title: Build a personal booking page overnight with two agents
summary: A developer had Claude Code build a booking app and Codex check it overnight; he says his site for booking video calls was live by Sunday.
agent_role: Claude Code built the app and Codex reviewed it while the author slept. The author came up with the idea and launched the site.
outcome: Author reports going from idea on Saturday lunch to a live booking site by Sunday.
what_they_did: The poster had the idea for his own booking app over lunch on a Saturday. He set Claude Code to build it and Codex to review the work overnight while he slept. The result is a page where people book 30-minute Google Meet video calls with him.
how_it_went: He says the app was live by Sunday. It is now his public booking page.
prompt: Build me a simple booking web app: visitors pick a [30]-minute slot from my availability in [time zone], enter their details, and get a [Google Meet] invite. After building, review your own code for bugs and security issues, fix them, and write tests. Show me a summary and a local preview, and wait for my approval before deploying anything.

curation.rationale: A real overnight build-and-review loop with a live result, but it is a familiar agent-built-my-app story with few process details.
